scope: Offline calculation of an explicit anonymized cold evidence packet; no live collection or judging
survival: k out of 12: occurred decisions judged found-with-node with a versioned node; missing decisions never survive
whole: Completed, at most two missing decisions; stopped or infrastructure-invalid slots excluded, never silently retried; three slots per arm
aggregation: Median k over whole runs, lower of two; spread max(k)-min(k); fewer than two whole runs cannot compare
pair: Absolute delta of median k and r=max(spreads); r>delta indistinguishable; delta>=3 and r<=1 selects greater survival
secondary: Otherwise median calls/12 and median total traversals over whole runs, WORSE (larger) of two whole runs; call improvement at least 20%, traversal improvement at least one; winner improves one without losing the other, survival cannot be lower; equality/conflict indistinguishable
selection: A selected arm must win both its pairs; otherwise report all pairs without selecting
satellite: Frozen allowed choices unchanged; realized choice and reasoning extracted only from the case journal before judging reader responses, never from graph writes or agent reports
boundaries: Percentage of larger calls (100 to 80); denominator always 12, never surviving decisions; 0/0 equal, zero vs positive better (100%), no division by zero; no worse means neither raw secondary median increases
pending: Parent integrates guard before final launch freeze; this freeze is intermediate only
